avis.titre: This peel works amazingly for me.
avis.texte: I wish I could buy a million bottles if this thing has an indefinite shelf life. It feels like the 20% glycolic acid peels I used to have once a week and gives me the same amazing results minus the skin peeling. It does tingle my skin but the sensation doesn’t last more than 10 minutes on me, definitely tolerable and I don’t get any lasting damage from it, my face doesn’t even turn red for more than 5 seconds. It’s just like putting a serum on my face with this product versus prepping my skin and putting on acids, set up a timer and wash it off. So much more convenient and so much more pleasant texture. Forget about the hydrating part, this thing is effectively a chemical peel so know your skin and patch test on your chin to see if you can tolerate it. If you can’t but really want to use it I guess you can always put it on and wash it off after a few minutes to see if you can eventually build up tolerance. This is an amazing product just have your expectations straight and know it’s strong and might not be for you, but if it is for you then I’m 99% sure you’ll love it like I do! Edit: 4th time using it and my skin already not tingling nearly as much, almost none exist tonight. I’m so excited! I’m on 0.05% tretinoin every night and 15% azelaic acid morning and night. I skip tret on milk peel night but keep the azelaic acid. Pore size already improved.

This is a must have, holy grail product. I am an avid skin care consumer and user and I'm always trying to find the next best thing. I have historically had oily skin with really stubborn cystic acne. The acne has calmed down over the years but it's still an issue along with clogged pores, enlarged pores, rough and patchy skin, blackheads, hyperpigmentation and milia. I've always used products with various acids to help with cell turnover along with physical exfoliants to remove dead skin but you have to be careful with these kinds of products because overuse can cause irritation and dry skin and exacerbate existing problems. Prequel is the perfect balance of very gentle but also very effective exfoliation. It leaves my skin softer and brighter and somehow also adds a ton of hydration. Since my skin is used to acids, I'm able to use Prequel every day. I apply it to a round, flat cotton pad and rub it all over my face and neck. I go over certain problem areas and second time. I let it dry and then apply any additional serums and treatments. I was able to notice a difference after the first use. My pores were smaller and my skin just looked brighter. With consistent use, it's gently brought comedones and clogged pores to the surface and lightened dark spots. It also worked wonders for my lips. I've had chronically dry, cracked, painful, peeling lips for years. I have tried every balm, mask, oil, serum, and gel imaginable to try to treat them. Nothing has ever worked until I acc

This is a strong exfoliating peel, and it definitely works. The milk texture spreads easily and feels controlled, but you can tell right away that this is not a beginner exfoliant. At 15% glycolic acid, it delivers noticeable smoothing and brightness when used carefully. I started slowly and kept my routine very simple afterward, focusing on hydration and barrier support. Used this way, it helped refine texture and made my skin look clearer and more even. When I increased usage too quickly, I noticed dryness, which was a good reminder that this peel needs to be respected. I would recommend this to experienced skincare users who are comfortable with chemical exfoliation and understand the importance of spacing treatments and supporting the skin barrier. It’s effective, but not something to rush or overuse. I used less than the recommended amount and it was still a little spicy for me.

THIS IS IT. This needs to be a permanent beauty staple item in your toolkit! I use Dennis Gross acid wipes for my face, it has erased my melasma with maintenance of course but this stuff is THE item for your body and crepey skin. Dennis Gross wipes are too expensive and small to use over your whole body. Amlactin is amazing but it does have that signature lactic acid smell and sometimes I don’t want lotion on me. I had never heard of Prequel before this. It was cheap enough and had all the acids I was looking for. I’ve only been using it for one week and it definitely has all the lactic acid magic in it! The wrinkle bend creases on my wrists are gone. My sun damage freckles and spots are fading. It’s so fast and easy to use. It dries fast. I put it on my arms and legs every single night while watching my bedtime TV routine. I’m here to buy a second bottle. I’m not a bot! Ladies we need this. I’ll update some photos later on. I’m sad I didn’t take a before photo. Also, remember any lactic acid products you MUST wear sunscreen after/during treatment. It makes you more prone to burn. I haven’t used this on my chest area sun damage but I have used PTR acid products there and it works phenomenally. Sometimes it pills so I may switch to this for my chest.

avis.titre: Gentle Exfoliation With a Surprisingly Hydrating FeelGentle Exfoliation With a Surprisingly Hydrating Feel
avis.texte: I was honestly surprised by how much product you get for the price. The bottle is large, and since I use it on both my face and body several nights a week, that makes a big difference. What stands out to me is the texture. It's milky and lightweight, not harsh or overly strong feeling like some exfoliating products can be. I apply it all over my body as well as my face to help remove dead skin, and it leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and hydrated afterward. I've found that it absorbs easily, doesn't leave behind a sticky residue, and fits well into my evening routine. With regular use, my skin feels more refreshed and has a smoother overall texture. I also like that it provides exfoliation without leaving my skin feeling stripped or dry. If you're looking for an exfoliating treatment that feels comfortable to use and offers a generous amount of product for the price, this one has been a great addition to my routine.

The best. This contains a blend of 15% aha acids. 15% can be strong but I think bc of the formula it’s actually gentle. My skin is dry and sensitive and this doesn’t irritate me. I use on the face and body. For the face I do once a week. For the body I use three times and my body feels great. Glycolic acid at that percentage does help with anti aging for this skin and collagen production.

I have been enjoying this peel. My skin does well with manual exfoliation and needs it like microdermabrasion and microneedling. I have been trying to cut down on costs and thought I should start chemical exfoliation. I recently tried the Dr. Dennis Peel Pad. I only used it once and didn't notice anything different in one use (I'm sure that's not a fair rating) BUT with one use of the prequel milky peel, I did experience the post glow effect and my skin didn't feel dry. I was able to use it every night for three days with no negative effects. With that alone, it made my pores appear smaller and lightened two dark spots. I am continuing to use it every other night :) This is also my first prequel product so I am excited to try more in the future.

avis.titre: Gentle enough that I actually keep using itGentle enough that I actually keep using it
avis.texte: I love this. I use it twice a week and my skin looks smoother the next morning without the raw, stripped feeling I get from harsher peels. It goes on like a light milk, so it spreads easily and I do not waste product. No stinging and no redness on my sensitive spots. The bottle is big, so it will last me a while. This replaced two other exfoliants in my routine.
Excelente, exfolia sin irritar. La piel se ve y se siente más suave, me encantó. Sólo lo uso una vez a la semana y es suficiente.
Works WONDERS!!!! I literally will buy this 100 more times!!!!

I seriously love this brand. First of all, its high-quality, tested by dermatologist and so effective. The price point is also phenomenal. The multi acid milk peel works so well. I’ve been using this for about a month and I love how it is made my skin feel annd look. It’s so much smoother and brighter. It’s easy to use as well. I just put a few drops on my face after I’ve washed it and then put my rest of my skin care on top. So easy and so effective.

I’m really impressed with this peel. It gives you that smooth, fresh-skin feeling without any burning or irritation. The texture is milky and lightweight, and it spreads easily so you don’t need much. I love that it uses a blend of gentle acids my skin looks brighter and more even the next morning. I have sensitive skin and this didn’t cause redness or dryness at all. It’s perfect for those times when you want a quick exfoliation but nothing harsh. Overall it’s become one of my go-to products for keeping my skin looking clear and glowy.

avis.titre: Know your facts before not liking!
avis.texte: Only use once a week and you’ll see great results. It is a very strong product so if you have sensitive skin I might stay away. It does have a tingling sensation at first that goes away. Totally normal. Makes my skin so soft, only used twice and it has already made a difference in my skin texture and dark spots.
One of the gentlest peels I’ve ever tried I started with once a week and moved up to twice but even with my sensitive skin I haven’t had any irritation

The product itself appears to be good and has the features I expected. However, because it appeared to have been previously opened, I wasn’t confident that I was evaluating a brand-new item. As a result, I can’t fairly review the product’s quality or performance.

I used this and it made me break out. I read so many of the reviews that said it was good and just had to try it. I have used their other products such as the Half and Half, hand cream, and other items, and love those. This product though, made my face very "tingly", too tingly for my liking. Then the next day I woke up to a break out. I don't have sensitive skin and I don't have acne prone skin. So this is a no for me. I don't recommend and no I wouldn't repurchase.
So disappointed. This product arrives with no box, no seal, and the edges of the lid clearly show a change in the texture, as if it has been opened and closed numerous times. Must return
